files.body:
Version 2 will expand the protocol beyond the current ping round-trip with additional message types, clearer encoding and decoding behavior, stronger validation, and a more extensible foundation for future client-server features, while preserving compatibility with the existing v1 message flow wherever practical.

Shipped: v2 `Hello` messages with the explicit `v:2|hello:<name>` envelope.
